audience: freelancers, agencies and teams who track time on projects and clients in Clockify

useCases.title: Summarize tracked hours by project, user or client
useCases.text: The AI runs a summary report for a date range, grouped for example by user then project, with tracked time and amounts, so you see where hours went.

useCases.title: List every time entry in a period
useCases.text: The AI reads a detailed report of all time entries, with user, project, client, task, tags, description and duration, or one user's entries with filters.

useCases.title: Check if a timer is running and on what
useCases.text: The AI reads the running timer of a user and tells you the project and description, or that no timer is running.

useCases.title: Review projects, clients, tasks and tags
useCases.text: The AI lists projects with client, billable flag and tracked duration, and the clients, tasks and tags of your workspace.

useCases.title: Log time, start a timer or stop it
useCases.text: The AI adds a finished time entry for you, or starts a running timer on a project, and stops the running timer at a time you choose.

useCases.title: Correct or delete a time entry
useCases.text: The AI changes a time entry's start, end, description, project, task, tags or billable flag, or permanently deletes it.
